SELECT hliw.*,
(select hbt.description from hls_business_type hbt where hbt.document_category= 'WARRANT_TYPE' and hbt.business_type = hliw.file_type) file_type_n,
(select hdt.description from hls_document_type hdt where hdt.document_category = 'WARRANT_TYPE' and hdt.business_type =hliw.file_type and hdt.document_type =hliw.warrant_type) warrant_type_n,
(select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'WARRANT_INOUT_STATUS' and scv.value = hliw.warrant_status) warrant_status_n, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'WARRANT_DOCUMENT_TYPE' and scv.value = hliw.document_type) document_type_n, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'WARRANT_DOCUMENT_CLASS' and scv.value = hliw.document_class) document_class_n,
(select wm_concat(fa.attachment_id) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_WARRANT' and hliw.warrant_id = fam.table_pk_value) attachment_id,
(select wm_concat(fa.file_name) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_WARRANT' and hliw.warrant_id = fam.table_pk_value) file_name,
(select max(fa.creation_date) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_WARRANT' and hliw.warrant_id = fam.table_pk_value) upload_date,
(select max(su.description) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam, sys_user su where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_WARRANT' and hliw.warrant_id = fam.table_pk_value and su.user_id = fa.created_by) upload_person, (select sc.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v sc where sc.code = 'BP.BP_MASTER_ROLE_CARD' and sc.code_value = hliw.bp_type) bp_type_n
FROM HLS_LEASE_ITEM_WARRANT hliw where hliw.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT hliw.*,
(select hbt.description from hls_business_type hbt where hbt.document_category= 'WARRANT_TYPE' and hbt.business_type = hliw.file_type) file_type_n,
(select hdt.description from hls_document_type hdt where hdt.document_category = 'WARRANT_TYPE' and hdt.business_type =hliw.file_type and hdt.document_type =hliw.warrant_type) warrant_type_n,
(select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'WARRANT_INOUT_STATUS' and scv.value = hliw.warrant_status) warrant_status_n, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'WARRANT_DOCUMENT_TYPE' and scv.value = hliw.document_type) document_type_n, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'WARRANT_DOCUMENT_CLASS' and scv.value = hliw.document_class) document_class_n,
(select wm_concat(fa.attachment_id) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_WARRANT' and hliw.warrant_id = fam.table_pk_value) attachment_id,
(select wm_concat(fa.file_name) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_WARRANT' and hliw.warrant_id = fam.table_pk_value) file_name,
(select max(fa.creation_date) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_WARRANT' and hliw.warrant_id = fam.table_pk_value) upload_date,
(select max(su.description) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam, sys_user su where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_WARRANT' and hliw.warrant_id = fam.table_pk_value and su.user_id = fa.created_by) upload_person, (select sc.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v sc where sc.code = 'BP.BP_MASTER_ROLE_CARD' and sc.code_value = hliw.bp_type) bp_type_n
FROM warrant_stock_ln wsl left join hls_lease_item_warrant hliw on hliw.warrant_id = wsl.warrant_id
wsl.warrant_stock_id = #{warrantStockId}
